encounters.introProse: You turn to inspect the corridor behind you and freeze. A coarse rag hangs in mid-air as if an invisible figure stands beneath it. A toxic vapor rolls off its folds, turning your vision blurry as your soles feel as though they are sinking into the floorboards.
encounters.approachProse: The levitating fabric hovers motionless at human eye level, waiting.

victoryOutcome.text: You strike aside the floating shroud! The fabric falls limp onto the floorboards, revealing absolutely nothing underneath. Your footing solidifies and your vision clears.

addJournalChronicle.title: The Rag in the Hall
addJournalChronicle.text: Defeated the paranormal hanging cloth in the corridor. It possessed no physical body beneath the weave.

encounters.introProse: As the kitchen lights flicker and pop, a familiar coarse rag materializes beside the steel counter, drifting toward you with suffocating malice.

victoryOutcome.text: The cloth collapses upon the kitchen tile, motionless. You tear away a saturated strip of its weave as the oppressive hum in your ears subsides.

encounters.introProse: You step past the counter when suddenly a dark human-like silhouette sprints from behind the pantry door, charging straight at you before vanishing into shadow!

victoryOutcome.text: You sidestep and slash through the charging silhouette! It disperses with the sound of snapping bone, leaving only sharp glass shards behind.

encounters.introProse: At the far end of the carpeted hallway, a cloud of grey dust erupts with sparkling fire embers, accompanied by an eerie tune that echoes down the corridor.

victoryOutcome.text: The swirling ember cloud dissipates into the carpet. In the sudden dead silence, a polished wind-up music box sits rattling inside the alcove ahead.

addJournalChronicle.title: The Music Box in the Ash
addJournalChronicle.text: Silenced the musical ember cloud in the hallway. Ahead in the alcove, an ornate wind-up music box still vibrates.

encounters.introProse: You step onto squishing floorboards in the dim light. From the blood-stained ceiling above, heavy organic matter detaches and strikes downward in an aggressive cascade!

victoryOutcome.text: You sever the descending masses with clinical detachment! The dripping ceases and the overhead lights pop back on, revealing the expanded expanse of the gut-spattered room.

addJournalChronicle.title: The Visceral Ceiling
addJournalChronicle.text: Cleared the aggressive anatomical matter in the gut room. Found blood-tempered iron embedded in the residue.

encounters.introProse: As you navigate the narrow wooden walls of the maze, the lights pop. Ahead in the blind turn, the levitating rag seals the passage while a darting silhouette lunges from the shadowed bend behind it!

victoryOutcome.text: You pin the cloth against the cedar paneling and cut down the lunging shadow behind it. The air clears, revealing the continuation of the maze corridor.

encounters.introProse: The judgment hall seals behind you. The crimson numerals IX through I burn on all four walls. In the center, the green armchair dissolves into a towering, shrieking manifestation of every life Vermin dismantled, flanked by a hovering Shroud of the Indictment. It is time for the accounting.

victoryOutcome.text: With unyielding precision, you dismantle the manifestation piece by piece. The screaming fades into total, absolute stillness. The cold alloy key to the waking room threshold materializes upon the floor.

addJournalChronicle.title: The Verdict Overcome
addJournalChronicle.text: Faced the embodiment of all past atrocities in the Judgment Hall. The entity dissolved, leaving the Key to the Verdict.
